_provenance.notes: Alaska's seafood processing sector has consolidated dramatically since 1990 — from 160+ active canneries and processors to approximately 35 major facilities. The consolidation was driven by: (1) salmon price crash 1999-2005 — many small canneries went bankrupt; (2) Japanese market consolidation — fewer, larger buyers; (3) automation replacing labor; (4) AFA 1998 — pollock processing consolidated to 6 shore-based plants and 6 at-sea catcher-processors. Today, five companies (Trident Seafoods, UniSea, Icicle Seafoods, Peter Pan Seafoods, Pacific Seafood) process over 50% of Alaska's total seafood volume.
